name: Deepak Spinners Limited
about: Deepak Spinners Limited manufactures and sells synthetic staple and man-made fiber blended yarns in India and internationally. The company offers various yarn products, including polyester, acrylic, viscose, and polyester viscose and acrylic blends, as well as carpet pile yarns-acrylic and line blends with poly-viscose, trilobal/polyester blends, and high bulk acrylic and bulk poly-acrylic yarns. It also exports its products to Syria, the Middle East, Turkey, Belgium, and the United States. Deepak Spinners Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Kolkata, India.
